import json, os, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

root = os.getcwd()
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
data = os.path.join(tmp.name, 'nested', 'store.json')

def start():
    p = subprocess.Popen(['python3','server.py','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','0','--data',data], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    line = p.stdout.readline().strip()
    assert line.startswith('LISTENING '), (line, p.stderr.read())
    return p, int(line.split()[1])

def call(port, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    payload = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
    req = Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}', data=payload, method=method, headers=headers or {})
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=3) as r:
            raw = r.read()
            return r.status, dict(r.headers), (json.loads(raw) if raw else None)
    except HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read()
        return e.code, dict(e.headers), (json.loads(raw) if raw else None)

p, port = start()
try:
    assert call(port,'GET','/health')[0::2] == (200, {'status':'ok'})
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%20b',{'value': {'x':[1,None]}})[0] == 201
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%20b',{'value': 2})[0] == 200
    assert call(port,'GET','/v1/kv/a%20b')[2] == {'key':'a b','value':2}
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/z',{'value':0})[0] == 201
    assert call(port,'GET','/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys':['a b','z']}
    for body in [b'{', b'[]', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":0}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":NaN}', b'{\"ttl_seconds\":1}', b'{\"value\":NaN}']:
        assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/bad',body,{'Content-Type':'application/json'})[0] == 400
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/',{'value':1})[0] == 400
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%2Fb',{'value':1})[0] == 400
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/%FF',{'value':1})[0] == 400
    assert call(port,'POST','/health',{})[0] == 405
    assert call(port,'GET','/nope')[0] == 404
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/temp',{'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.15})[0] == 201
    time.sleep(.2)
    assert call(port,'GET','/v1/kv/temp')[0] == 404
    assert call(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z')[0] == 204
    assert call(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z')[0] == 404
    huge = b'{\"value\":\"' + b'x' * (1024*1024) + b'\"}'
    assert call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/huge',huge,{'Content-Type':'application/json'})[0] == 413
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    assert p.wait(timeout=5) == 0, p.stderr.read()

p2, port2 = start()
try:
    assert call(port2,'GET','/v1/keys')[2] == {'keys':['a b']}
    assert call(port2,'GET','/v1/kv/a%20b')[2] == {'key':'a b','value':2}
finally:
    p2.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    assert p2.wait(timeout=5) == 0, p2.stderr.read()

with open(data, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    persisted = json.load(f)
assert set(persisted['entries']) == {'a b'}
print('SELFTEST OK')
PY"

import json, os, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); data=os.path.join(tmp.name,'nested','store.json')
def start():
 p=subprocess.Popen(['python3','server.py','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','0','--data',data],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 line=p.stdout.readline().strip(); print('startup',line); assert line.startswith('LISTENING '); return p,int(line.split()[1])
def call(port,method,path,body=None,headers=None):
 payload=None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body,bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
 req=Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}',data=payload,method=method,headers=headers or {})
 try:
  with urlopen(req,timeout=3) as r: raw=r.read(); return r.status,dict(r.headers),json.loads(raw) if raw else None
 except HTTPError as e: raw=e.read(); return e.code,dict(e.headers),json.loads(raw) if raw else None
def check(name, got, predicate):
 print(name,got); assert predicate(got), name
p,port=start()
try:
 check('health',call(port,'GET','/health'),lambda x:x[0]==200 and x[2]=={'status':'ok'})
 check('create',call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%20b',{'value':{'x':[1,None]}}),lambda x:x[0]==201)
 check('replace',call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a%20b',{'value':2}),lambda x:x[0]==200)
 check('get',call(port,'GET','/v1/kv/a%20b'),lambda x:x[2]=={'key':'a b','value':2})
 check('create-z',call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/z',{'value':0}),lambda x:x[0]==201)
 check('keys',call(port,'GET','/v1/keys'),lambda x:x[2]=={'keys':['a b','z']})
 for i,body in enumerate([b'{',b'[]',b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":0}',b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":NaN}',b'{\"ttl_seconds\":1}',b'{\"value\":NaN}']):
  check(f'bad-body-{i}',call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/bad',body,{'Content-Type':'application/json'}),lambda x:x[0]==400)
 for name,path in [('empty','/v1/kv/'),('slash','/v1/kv/a%2Fb'),('escape','/v1/kv/%ZZ'),('utf8','/v1/kv/%FF')]:
  check(name,call(port,'PUT',path,{'value':1}),lambda x:x[0]==400)
 check('unknown',call(port,'GET','/nope'),lambda x:x[0]==404)
 check('method',call(port,'POST','/health',{}),lambda x:x[0]==405)
 check('delete',call(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z'),lambda x:x[0]==204 and x[2] is None)
 check('delete-missing',call(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z'),lambda x:x[0]==404)
 check('ttl-put',call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/t',{'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.15}),lambda x:x[0]==201)
 time.sleep(.25)
 check('ttl-get',call(port,'GET','/v1/kv/t'),lambda x:x[0]==404)
 check('too-large',call(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/large',b'x'*(1024*1024+1),{'Content-Type':'application/json'}),lambda x:x[0]==413)
finally:
 p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p.wait(timeout=5); print('exit',p.returncode,'stderr=',p.stderr.read())
p,port=start()
try:
 check('restart-get',call(port,'GET','/v1/kv/a%20b'),lambda x:x[2]=={'key':'a b','value':2})
 check('restart-keys',call(port,'GET','/v1/keys'),lambda x:x[2]=={'keys':['a b']})
finally:
 p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p.wait(timeout=5); print('restart-exit',p.returncode,'stderr=',p.stderr.read())
print('SELFTEST OK',open(data,encoding='utf-8').read())

            self._error(404, "key not found")
            return
        self.send_response(204)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
        self.end_headers()

    def _unsupported(self, send_body: bool = True) -> None:
        path = self._path()
        key, problem = self._key(path)
        known = path in {"/health", "/v1/keys"} or problem != "route"
        if not known:
            self._error(404, "unknown route", send_body=send_body)
            return
        del key
        self.send_response(405)
        self.send_header("Allow", "GET, PUT, DELETE")
        encoded = json.dumps({"error": "method not allowed"}, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(encoded)))
        self.end_headers()
        if send_body:
            self.wfile.write(encoded)

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        self._unsupported()

    def do_PATCH(self) -> None:
        self._unsupported()

    def do_OPTIONS(self) -> None:
        self._unsupported()

    def do_HEAD(self) -> None:
        self._unsupported(send_body=False)


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Persistent HTTP key-value service")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--data", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not 0 <= args.port <= 65535:
        parser.error("--port must be between 0 and 65535")
    return args


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    try:
        store = Store(args.data)
        server = Server((args.host, args.port), store)
    except (OSError, StoreError) as exc:
        print(f"startup error: {exc}", file=os.sys.stderr)
        return 1

    stopping = threading.Event()

    def stop(_signum: int, _frame: Any) -> None:
        stopping.set()

    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)
    server.timeout = 0.25
    print(f"LISTENING {server.server_address[1]}", flush=True)
    try:
        while not stopping.is_set():
            server.handle_request()
    finally:
        server.server_close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
